_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to 0.40.0's merge commit (still a SHA, not a tag -- pine-lang doesn't tag releases), which stops per-query logging deadlocking the server and stops connection pools leaking a database connection on every reconnect. beamlynx-ui unchanged at its tagged 0.52.0.
